text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD alert: sudden spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts for /v1/generate across prod-east-1. 5xx rate at 12% (baseline 0.3%), p50 latency up from 80ms to 1.8s, p95 > 3s. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Pager sent to #incidents-primary and @sara (oncall).

sara: seeing it. acknowledging and jumping in. any recent deploys?

maria: nothing in the last 30m on model-serving. I see a routing change to the gateway edge in the last 2h (PR #4312) but that was low risk.

sara: ok start triage. I'll check gateway pods and NLB health, also tail the gateway logs for 502/504s. jon, can you check model pool latency and any hotspot on GPU nodes? tiago, can you look at infra metrics (ksm/kubelet errors, node pressure)?

jon: on it. quick check shows one model pool (rnnd-13b) has high queueing and some OOM kills in the last 10m on gpu-3 node.

tiago: infra looks healthy overall, but the autoscaler for dedicated pools didn't scale up to handle burst — limits hit on that pool. might be related.

sara: logs: lots of `upstream request timeout` and `502` from the gateway to inference runtime. Example excerpt:

```
2026-03-14T09:42:12Z gateway[proxy]: upstream request timeout route=/v1/generate id=req-9b3... code=504 latency=3001ms
2026-03-14T09:42:13Z gateway[proxy]: upstream response 502 route=/v1/generate backend=runtime-12 reason=connection-reset
```

sara: mitigation plan: 1) flip circuit-breaker to short-circuit heavy routes to smaller model variant, 2) increase concurrency limit on the inference pool temporarily, 3) add retry/backoff on gateway for transient 502s, 4) if that fails, roll back recent edge routing change. I'll try (1) and (2) first.

maria: support note: customers might see degraded throughput or higher 429s while we throttle. Posting banner to status page after initial mitigation.

sara: applying circuit-breaker rule now to route `/v1/generate` traffic with seq_len > 1024 to `rnnd-7b` fallback (config change). CLI snippet: 

```sh
redwoodctl routing set --route \"/v1/generate\" --circuit-breaker \"seq_len>1024->rnnd-7b\" --reason \"prod latency spike 1770023345\"
```

sara: also bumping pool concurrency for rnnd-13b from 16 -> 24 temporarily: 

```sh
kubectl -n inference scale deployment rnnd-13b-pool --replicas=6
```

deploy-bot: deployment rnnd-13b-pool scaled to 6 replicas (k8s).

sara: initial impact: 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 4.5% in 3m, p95 latency down to 1.2s. still elevated but trending better. status: partial mitigation.

jon: the OOMs were caused by a single noisy tenant with long sequences; throttled their requests via quota while we stabilize. Added temporary rate-limit for their token usage.

tiago: autoscaler didn't spin up because the scale policy has a cooldown of 10m and it was already in cooldown from a previous burst. we should tune that (action item).

sara: good catch. next: I'm going to enable a tighter alert so we don't get overwhelmed by noisy tenants in future. For now, I'm going to rollback the recent edge routing change if metrics don't drop to near baseline in 10m.

(8m later)

sara: after the circuit-breaker and scaling we've stabilized. 5xx ~0.6%, p95 ~200ms. I'm going to leave the temporary changes in place for 30m and then plan a hotfix to make them durable.

maria: status page updated: "Degraded performance for text generation endpoints in prod-east-1. Mitigation underway. No data loss reported." :white_check_mark:

jon: capturing root cause: combination of a noisy tenant (long seq requests) + autoscaler cooldown + edge routing change that increased the fanout to our largest model pool. That created request pileup and OOMs on a subset of gpu nodes.

sara: creating follow-up tickets and actions:
- HOTFIX: adjust routing rules to default to smaller model on overload and drop immediate fanout increase by changing edge config. (ticket: INF-9203)
- RUNBOOK: add step to temporarily circuit-break broken routes and how to do the CLI command (RN). (ticket: INF-9204)
- ALERT TUNING: change autoscaler cooldown and add a synthetic canary to detect long-sequence storms. (ticket: INF-9205)
- CUSTOMER COMM: outreach to the noisy tenant and offer mitigation guidance. (ticket: CS-4512)

tiago: I'm drafting the autoscaler param change: reduce cooldown to 2m for bursty pools, and add scale-up step policy for queued_request_count > 200. Will link PR.

maria: I'll open the CS ticket and ping the account team. Also recommend adding a usage cap for auto-scaling pools per tenant.

sara: hotfix patch (small edge routing change) prepared. Applying to prod behind canary (5% traffic) now: 

```yaml
# edge routing delta
- name: fanout_multiplier
  from: 3
  to: 2
  reason: throttle fanout during high-latency events
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy of edge-routing patch rolled out to 5% - health OK.

sara: canary looks good. promoting to 100% in 4m.

(4m later)

deploy-bot: Deploy to 100% complete. No increase in errors.

sara: confirmed stable across regions. Closing immediate mitigation loop. Last 5xx at 0.4% (near baseline). I'll leave the scaled replicas and circuit-breaker in place until tomorrow morning.

jon: adding note: add more granular alert for the gateway to break out 502 vs 504 vs 503 and correlate with backend OOM events. Also capture `seq_len` distribution in the alert.

sara: handoff to next oncall @jon — summary in one line: noisy long-seq tenant caused queue buildup + autoscaler cooldown + routing fanout increased pressure -> hotfix reduced fanout and circuit-breaker to smaller model, scaled pool temporarily. Tickets: INF-9203/9204/9205; CS-4512.

jon: taking over. I'll monitor for 1h and then update runbook with exact commands used.

maria: action items assigned: INF-9203 (sara), INF-9204 (jon), INF-9205 (tiago), CS-4512 (maria). I'll set SLAs on the tickets.

sara: thanks team. Postmortem follow-ups:
- write a one-page RCA (owner: sara, due 2026-03-16)
- add synthetic test sending random long-seq traffic to catch autoscaler edge cases (owner: tiago)
- tune alert thresholds and add seq_len histogram to dashboards (owner: jon)
- update runbook with circuit-breaker commands and a quick list of k8s commands used (owner: jon)

incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV-2 while mitigations were active. Time to mitigation: ~9 minutes.

sara: leaving a quick snippet for runbook (so we don't lose it):

```sh
# circuit-breaker to smaller model
redwoodctl routing set --route \"/v1/generate\" --circuit-breaker \"seq_len>1024->rnnd-7b\"

# scale pool
kubectl -n inference scale deployment rnnd-13b-pool --replicas=6

# edge fanout rollback
# apply edge config patch in repo and `redwoodctl deploy edge --canary 5` then promote
```

jon: will add this to runbook and push PR with the autoscaler tuning + alert changes.

maria: I'll follow up with the customer and log the mitigation steps.

sara: closing thread for now. If anything spikes, ping @jon or escalate. Great work. :tada:
